text:
Miranda: heads up — we got multiple reports this morning where the enforcer returned 429s but the usage eventually showed up in billing. looks like metering ingest lag vs enforcement window
Ajay: saw the alert too. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ops/d/ingest/enforcer-lag (high error rate around 06:12 UTC) :grimacing:
Kevin: is this mostly per-org bursts or a global ingestion delay? any customer examples?
Miranda: example logs for org=org_42 — enforcer rejected at 06:12:05 with reason=quota_exceeded, but ingester shows events for that org with timestamps 06:11:58..06:12:10 arriving at 06:12:40
Miranda: ```json
{"time":"06:12:05","org":"org_42","action":"reject","reason":"quota_exceeded","enforcer_window":"1m"}
{"time":"06:12:40","org":"org_42","event":"usage_report","tokens":120}
```
Sophia: short term we should widen the enforcement grace window for per-key burst buckets by +30s. that will reduce false positives while we debug ingest backlog :+1:
Ajay: widening window reduces customer-facing errors but risks letting past-the-limit traffic through for a bit. revenue / abuse tradeoff. can we make it conditional (only when ingestion_lag > X)?
Kevin: we could gate on the ingester watermark. if ingester_head_delay > 10s then switch enforcer into "soft mode": emit warning + allow up to burst+10% rather than hard reject
Miranda: plan suggestion: 1) emergency: enable conditional soft-mode when kafka-lag (ingest) > 10s 2) quick fix: increase ingester consumer parallelism and backfill replay frequency 3) medium: add pending_count metric surfaced to console + API response header so customers see approximate used tokens
Sophia: longer term we should move enforcement to read compacted counters from the ingestion topic (compact kafka table) so enforcer has the same source-of-truth. that's more work but removes race between real-time enforcement and eventual metering
Ajay: that is the ideal but we need to evaluate complexity. compacted topic reads mean enforcer needs to maintain a local store (rocksdb/redis) and watch changefeed. can we prototype with redis streaming from the ingester?
Kevin: I ran a sim locally: with a 1m leaky-bucket and conditional soft_mode the false 429s drop ~92% while peak allowed overage is ~7%. seems acceptable for now.
Miranda: sample SQL to compute backlog by org for dashboards:
```sql
SELECT org_id, max(ingest_time) - max(event_time) AS lag_ms, count(*) AS queued_events
FROM ingestion.events
WHERE event_time > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY org_id
ORDER BY lag_ms DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Sophia: add alert: (ingest_lag_p95 > 15s AND enforcer_429_rate > 0.5%) => trigger paging and auto-soft-mode. also add grafana panels: "enforcer-mode","ingest-watermark","pending-token-estimate"
Ajay: operational checklist for emergency toggle: how to rollback if soft-mode causes abuse?
Miranda: rollback = flip feature-flag to strict mode, then enable stricter throttles on gateway edge to stop obvious spikes. we keep audit logs of soft-allowed requests for reconciliation and potential chargeback
opsbot: deploy-bot: starting canary rollout of ingest-consumer parallelism increase to staging cluster at 08:40 UTC
deploy-bot: canary success, promoted to prod at 08:47 UTC :rocket:
Kevin: after consumer scale-up lag p95 dropped from 28s -> 6s in prod. good. we still need the conditional soft-mode for some edge customers
Sophia: I'll own implementing the feature-flag + conditional soft-mode (PR coming). plan: feature-flag default off, enable for 10% of traffic, run for 24h, measure enforcer_429 reduction and revenue delta
Ajay: I'll add the dashboard panels and the alert. Miranda — can you own the reconciliation playbook and audit query that finds soft-mode allowed requests for billing?
Miranda: yep. I'll add a playbook: steps to backfill, how to flag customers for chargeable backfill vs one-time credit. will post it in #incidents once drafted
Kevin: timeline sanity check: scoreboard -> consumer scaling done, dashboards + alerts by EOD, soft-mode feature flag PR by tomorrow, rollout gradual next week. sound right?
Miranda: sounds good. action items: Sophia implement flag, Ajay dashboards/alerts, Kevin validate sim and perf tests, Miranda reconciliation playbook. I'll schedule a follow-up touchpoint in 24h. :white_check_mark:
